visual_action: A montage shows a large, celebratory crowd gathered in front of the U.S. Supreme Court building. People are cheering, waving American flags, rainbow Pride flags, and other LGBTQ+ pride flags. Some individuals hold up signs, including one that reads 'MY FUTURE FAMILY ='.

cast.name: Supreme Court of the United States
cast.evidence: The on-screen text reads, 'SCOTUS just rejected a call to overturn marriage equality.'

on_screen_text.text: SCOTUS just rejected a call to overturn marriage equality. Love still wins ❤️

spoken_summary: The audio consists of an uplifting pop song with vocals. There is no spoken dialogue or narration.
audio_music: An uplifting, anthemic pop song with female vocals plays throughout the video, creating a celebratory and victorious mood.
editing_pacing: The video is a montage of several different shots of the crowd, cutting between wide shots and closer views of people celebrating.
central_claim: The Supreme Court has just rejected a call to overturn marriage equality, securing a victory for LGBTQ+ rights.
intended_effect: To create feelings of celebration, relief, and pride among supporters of marriage equality and to credit the current political climate for this victory.
uncertainty_flags: It is unclear if the footage is from the specific event described in the on-screen text or if it is stock footage from a previous celebration of marriage equality (such as the 2015 Obergefell v. Hodges decision).
